query:
Will a UK Standard Visitor visa applicant in the year 2025 get a vignette sticker visa or eVisa?

Immigrants in the UK who hold biometric residence permit (BRP) or biometric residence cards (BRC) now have to obtain an eVisa before 31 December 2024.

The guidance at https://www.gov.uk/guidance/online-immigration-status-evisa says:

The documents being replaced are:

  • biometric residence permits (BRP)
  • biometric residence cards (BRC)
  • passport endorsements, such as indefinite leave to enter wet ink stamps
  • vignette stickers in passports, such as entry clearance or visa vignettes

The last item seems to imply that the eVisa could be replacing all vignette stickers including the ones provided for UK Standard Visitor visa.

But https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor/apply-standard-visitor-visa says:

You must have a passport or travel document that is valid for the whole of your stay in the UK. There must be a blank page in your passport for your Standard Visitor visa.

This seems to imply that a vignette sticker will be pasted on a blank page of the passport.

So it is not clear to me if UK eVisa is replacing the vignette sticket for UK Standard Visitor or not. Do you know if it is? Where can we find more information about it?

As discussed in the comments, https://www.gov.uk/get-access-evisa says:

You cannot get access to an eVisa if you:

  • have a visa for less than 6 months, such as a visitor visa

But this does not address my question. The above guidance applies to someone who might already have a UK Standard Visitor visa which allows them to stay in the UK for less than 6 months. It is clear that they cannot get an eVisa on the basis of their current UK physical visa (the vignette sticker on their passport). To apply for eVisa before 31 Dec 2024, they must already have a physical visa that allows them to stay in the UK for longer than 6 months. But I want to know what type of visa a new UK Standard Visitor application is going to get in 2025. Will they get a vignette sticker or will they get an eVisa?

steps.step_instruction: Consult official UK government immigration websites for updates on visa documentation changes for 2025.
